RECENT DEVELOPMENTS LIQUIDS PIPELINES INVESTMENT Mainline System Capital Investment In 2025, we announced plans to invest up to US$1.3 billion in our Mainline System through 2028. These investments are expected to earn a return through the Mainline Tolling Settlement and will be focused on extending the service life of the underlying assets, as well as further enhancing reliability and efficiency given continuing demands on the system. NONCONTROLLING INTEREST INVESTMENT BC Pipeline System On July 2, 2025, Stonlasec8 Indigenous Investments Limited Partnership (the First Nations Partnership), an entity representing 38 First Nations in British Columbia (BC), invested approximately $736 million in our Westcoast Energy Inc. BC natural gas pipeline system. As at December 31, 2025, we own 87.53% of the BC Pipeline system, which is included in our Gas Transmission segment, and continue to manage and operate the pipeline system. The First Nations Partnership owns the remaining 12.47% interest. GAS TRANSMISSION RATE PROCEEDINGS Algonquin Algonquin Gas Transmission, LLC (Algonquin) filed a rate case on May 30, 2024 and a settlement in principle was reached with customers in December 2024. A Stipulation and Agreement was approved by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) on April 25, 2025 with rates effective December 1, 2024. Maritimes & Northeast Maritimes & Northeast (M&N) United States (US) filed a rate case on May 30, 2024 and a settlement in principle was reached with customers in December 2024. A Stipulation and Agreement was approved by the FERC on April 25, 2025 with rates effective January 1, 2025. The toll settlement agreement for M&N Canada expired in December 2025. M&N Canada reached a toll settlement with shippers for the effective period from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027. On December 15, 2025, M&N Canada filed the 2026–2027 toll settlement agreement with the Canada Energy Regulator (CER) for review and approval. A CER decision is expected in the first quarter of 2026. 63 East Tennessee East Tennessee Natural Gas, LLC (East Tennessee) filed a rate case on April 29, 2025. On May 29, 2025, the FERC issued an order accepting and suspending tariff records, subject to refund, conditions, and establishing hearing procedures. In compliance with the order, East Tennessee made a filing to implement the rates to be effective November 1, 2025, subject to refund. Settlement discussions with shippers commenced in the third quarter of 2025. Vector Vector Pipeline L.P. (Vector) filed a rate case on May 30, 2025. On June 30, 2025, the FERC issued an order accepting and suspending tariff records filed in this rate case, and establishing hearing procedures. In compliance with the order, Vector placed the proposed rates into effect on July 1, 2025. Additionally, on July 1, 2025, the chief administrative law judge issued an order consolidating Vector’s outstanding review of rates initiated by the FERC in 2024 with Vector’s May 30, 2025 rate case filing. credit_strengths.text: Enbridge's operating income and revenue have grown steadily across the three-year trend, with operating margin far above the sector median, reflecting the fee-based, take-or-pay nature of its liquids and gas transmission networks. This earnings quality underpins stable cash generation despite high absolute debt.

Operating cash flow remains substantial and covers capital expenditure, leaving positive free cash flow. Although free cash flow to debt is modest, the consistent conversion of EBITDA into cash supports the issuer's ability to service its obligations over time.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a large maturity wall, with a significant portion of borrowings due within the next twelve months and a further substantial amount in year two. Refinancing this profile in a higher-rate environment could pressure interest costs and liquidity.

Risk factors highlight ongoing rate proceedings, including the East Tennessee rate case where the FERC accepted and suspended tariff records subject to refund, and the Vector rate case with settlement discussions. Adverse outcomes could reduce future cash flows and challenge distribution coverage.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is weak relative to the sector median, and leverage sits far above the sector median, placing the issuer in the highly leveraged tier. The current ratio is also below one, indicating limited short-term liquidity headroom.

Free cash flow after capital expenditure is positive but small relative to debt, and dividends absorb most of it, leaving little cushion for debt reduction. The maturity profile requires regular refinancing, making cash flow sensitive to rate proceedings and toll settlements.

overall_credit_view.text: Enbridge's scale, contracted cash flows, and essential infrastructure assets provide a solid business foundation, but the financial risk profile is highly leveraged with net leverage well above the sector median. The indicative profile is not a rating, but it signals elevated credit risk.

Analyst judgement: the issuer's ability to deleverage depends on EBITDA growth and disciplined capital allocation. Shareholder distributions absorb most free cash flow, and the Altman Z double prime zone is distress, so credit quality remains sensitive to rate case outcomes and refinancing conditions.

credit_strengths.text: Enbridge的營運收入及收益在三年趨勢中穩步增長，營運利潤率遠高於行業中位數，反映其液體及氣體輸送網絡以收費為基礎、照付不議的性質。此盈利質量支撐穩定現金產生，儘管絕對債務水平高。
營運現金流仍然龐大，足以覆蓋資本開支，留下正自由現金流。儘管自由現金流對債務比率適度，EBITDA持續轉化為現金支持發行人長期償付責任的能力。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露龐大的到期牆，相當部分借款於未來十二個月內到期，第二年亦有進一步可觀金額。在較高利率環境下為此結構再融資可能對利息成本及流動性構成壓力。
風險因素強調持續的費率程序，包括East Tennessee費率案，其中FERC接受並暫緩關稅記錄，有待退款，以及Vector費率案正在進行和解討論。不利結果可能減少未來現金流並挑戰分派覆蓋率。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率相對於行業中位數疲弱，槓桿遠高於行業中位數，使發行人處於高槓桿級別。流動比率亦低於一，顯示短期流動性緩衝有限。
資本開支後自由現金流為正但相對於債務規模細小，且股息吸收大部分，留下甚少緩衝用於減債。到期結構需要定期再融資，使現金流對費率程序及通行費和解敏感。

overall_credit_view.text: Enbridge的規模、合約現金流及必要基礎設施資產提供穩固業務基礎，但財務風險狀況高度槓桿，淨槓桿遠高於行業中位數。指示性狀況並非評級，但顯示信用風險偏高。
分析師判斷：發行人去槓桿能力取決於EBITDA增長及紀律性資本配置。股東分派吸收大部分自由現金流，而Altman Z double prime區域為困境，故信用質量仍對費率案結果及再融資條件敏感。
